local function makeCapturedRegister(registers, index)
    return setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_, key)
            if key == 'value' then return registers[index] end
        end,
        __newindex = function(_, key, value)
            if key == 'value' then registers[index] = value end
        end,
    })
end
